definitions.explanation: The way a person's hair is cut, styled, or arranged.

examples.japanese: その{髪型|かみがた}、{似合|にあ}っているね。
{新|あたら}しい{髪型|かみがた}にしたいけど、どんなのがいいか{迷|まよ}っている。
examples.english: I want a new hairstyle, but I can't decide what kind would be good.

notes:
Compound of {髪|かみ} (hair) + {型|がた} (shape/style).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪型|かみがた}を{変|か}える (change one's hairstyle)
- {髪型|かみがた}が{似合|にあ}う (a hairstyle suits someone)
- {髪型|かみがた}にこだわる (be particular about hairstyle)

Synonyms include ヘアスタイル (hair style) and {髪形|かみがた} (same word, alternate kanji). {髪型|かみがた} is the most common spelling.
